title: Miner status feed (whitelist)
description: Whitelist-only status feed read by the iPhone app. Every key is required; absent data is an explicit null (shown as 無資料), undeterminable state is the string "unknown" (shown as 未知). Never pass through raw source state: no token, PID, log path, wallet, account, full command line or exception text. Receive time and monotonic time are recorded by the client and are NOT part of this payload.

dataOrigin.description: "demo" marks hand-written mock data. The app must show a visible demo banner and must never present it as a live connection.

demoNotice.description: Required non-empty text when dataOrigin is demo; null when live.

publishedAt.description: When the publisher wrote/served this document. Rewriting a cache file updates this but must NOT make any observedAt newer.

market.description: OPTIONAL extension, the only keys that may be absent: sent only to clients that ask for earnings (header X-Miner-Status-Features: earnings), so older apps keep receiving the base whitelist. Null when prices are unavailable.

tariff.description: OPTIONAL extension sent with market: the published Taipower simple two-stage time-of-use rates and upcoming weekday days off (billed off-peak all day). Null when never fetched.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time with explicit offset (Z or ±hh:mm). Local times without date/offset (e.g. log HH:MM:SS) must be null until calibrated.

machineId.description: Stable key. Sources are never merged across machineIds (thresholds, scripts, hashrate differ per machine).

worker.description: null when the source has no confirmed worker field. Never guessed from wallet data.

sourceStatus.description: Publisher's last attempt to read this machine. Anything other than ok means the sample fields below are historical at best.

sourceCheckedAt.description: When the publisher last attempted to read the source (success or failure).

sessionId.description: Opaque id of one mining run/job. Counters, stop results and sequences are only comparable within the same sessionId; a change means rebuild the baseline.

sampleSequence.description: Strictly increasing per sessionId at the source. Same or lower value within the same session = replay/stale, not new evidence.

observedAt.description: Data time: when the source observed this sample (source clock). Not trusted as absolute; the client bounds it with its own receive time.

expectedRunning.description: Persisted operator intent, not an observation. null when no reliable intent source; never inferred from minerRunning.

state.description: Observed miner child process state. A live guard/source script alone does not make this running.

hashrate.description: Reported rate may be reused from an old log line; its own observedAt decides freshness. hashrate > 0 alone never means green.

gpus.description: null when no GPU data; [] is not used to mean missing.

accepted.description: Cumulative within sessionId. Only an increase within the same session is new share evidence.

stale.description: null when not recorded; never defaulted to 0.

rejected.description: null when not recorded; never defaulted to 0.

lastAcceptedAt.description: Source time of the most recent accepted share in this session. null until date/timezone calibrated (log HH:MM:SS or process-monotonic values are not acceptable).

stop.description: Stop result. Applies only when stop.sessionId equals the machine sessionId; an older run's result is never shown as the current reason. Staleness/disconnect is NOT a stop reason.

reason.description: Classified, whitelisted category only. null = no stop recorded for this session.

earnings.description: OPTIONAL extension sent with feed.market (see there). Null when this machine has no pool estimate.

assessment.description: OPTIONAL extension (feature `assessment`): the publisher's own judgment, shown by the app while this sample is fresh. Null when the publisher has no judgment.

health.description: OPTIONAL extension (feature `assessment`): supporting details for the judgment.

market.description: Prices for converting estimated earnings. All USD prices; usdTwd is TWD per USD.

periodsMatch.description: False when the published time windows differ from the ones the app implements.

earnings.description: Pool-side estimate for one machine: coin per day at the pool's recent average hashrate, after the pool fee. An estimate, not the credited amount.

poolHashrate.description: H/s, the pool's recent average for this worker.

electricityBilled.description: Publisher's default for whether this machine's electricity costs money; the app lets the user override it.

assessment.description: Light, short title and plain-language reason decided by the publisher.

poolHashrate.description: H/s, the pool's recent (30 min) average for this worker.

temperatureLimitC.description: The miner's own protective cutoff, if known.
